name: influencer.tag_drop
description: Removes a tag from a person, the team's or the model's, and keeps the model from giving it back (the newest 100 removals of a person are kept). Every member of the person's company may. Answers the person's tags.
sql:
update brandbase.influencers i set
  tags_team = array_remove(i.tags_team, t.v),
  tags_ai = array_remove(i.tags_ai, t.v),
  tags_hidden = case when t.v = any (i.tags_hidden) then i.tags_hidden else (i.tags_hidden || t.v)[greatest(1, cardinality(i.tags_hidden) - 98):] end
from (select brandbase.tag_of(:tag::text) as v) t
where i.id = :id::uuid
returning jsonb_build_object('id', i.id, 'tags', brandbase.influencer_tags(i.tags_team, i.tags_ai)) as result
